sensors.name: line tracker as light % (compared with 90 and 95)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 % (dark), branch on the line tracker (below 90 % curve left, above 95 % curve right, otherwise call avoidWalls); otherwise call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 % (dark), turn away from a side obstacle or call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 % (dark), drive forward; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line if there is one under the robot and drive straight if there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.
